```sqlite
SELECT conta, SUM(centavos)
FROM movimentos
WHERE estado = 'pago'
GROUP BY conta
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
ORDER BY conta;
```

```sqlite
SELECT
  T1.conta,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.estado = 'pago' THEN T2.centavos ELSE 0 END), 0) AS soma_centavos_pagos
FROM movimentos AS T1
LEFT JOIN movimentos AS T2
  ON T1.conta = T2.conta AND T2.estado = 'pago'
GROUP BY
  T1.conta
ORDER BY
  T1.conta;
```
SELECT conta, SUM(centavos) AS soma_pagos FROM movimentos WHERE estado = 'pago' GROUP BY conta HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY conta ASC;

SELECT conta, COALESCE(SUM(centavos), 0) AS soma_pagos FROM movimentos WHERE estado = 'pago' GROUP BY conta UNION ALL SELECT conta, 0 FROM movimentos WHERE estado != 'pago' GROUP BY conta ORDER BY conta ASC;

SELECT conta, SUM(centavos) AS total_centavos
FROM movimentos
WHERE estado = 'pago'
GROUP BY conta
HAVING SUM(centavos) > 0
ORDER BY conta ASC;

SELECT conta, COALESCE(SUM(centavos), 0) AS total_centavos
FROM movimentos
WHERE estado = 'pago'
GROUP BY conta
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT conta, 0 AS total_centavos
FROM movimentos
WHERE estado != 'pago'
ORDER BY conta ASC;
